lead.title: DRAM shortage hits 'worst in history' as manufacturers open procurement war rooms
lead.summary: Electronics makers are standing up dedicated 'war rooms' to chase DRAM on eBay and through brokers amid what is being called the worst memory shortage in history, with PC-builder kit prices up about 500% in a year. SK hynix says 2027 will be the worst year and new fabs from Micron, Samsung and SK hynix are not expected online until 2028 — directly shaping RAM and VRAM capacity choices for local LLM rigs.

top_stories.title: Sber opens weights for GigaChat 4: 708B hybrid MoE, 41B active, native 1M-token context
top_stories.summary: GigaChat4-708B-A41B combines Gated DeltaNet layers, multi-head latent attention and DeepSeek Sparse Attention in an MIT-licensed hybrid MoE with Reasoning and Instant modes and notable Terminal-Bench 2.0 gains over GigaChat 3.5.

top_stories.title: llama.cpp publishes a public AMD benchmark dashboard for Ryzen and Radeon
top_stories.summary: The ggml-org project launched a weekly-refreshed dashboard tracking PP512 prompt-processing and TG128 generation throughput across llama.cpp builds, models and quantizations on Radeon 8060S and Radeon AI Pro R9700S hardware, with data hosted publicly on Hugging Face.

top_stories.title: OGX 2.0 unifies Ollama, llama.cpp, SGLang and vLLM behind one provider layer
top_stories.summary: The major release lands 133 PRs from 28 contributors, adding the SystemOne judgment model API across all four runtimes, a new SGLang inference provider with Tev1 support, namespaced function tools, a SearchApi web search backend and Python 3.14 support.

top_stories.title: Qwen upgrades Qwen-Audio-3.1 speech model to 59 ASR languages plus dialects
top_stories.summary: Alibaba's Qwen team expanded the Qwen-Audio-3.1 series: ASR covers 59 languages plus 8 Chinese dialects, TTS covers 65 languages plus 6 dialects, and realtime covers 53 languages plus 6 dialects, with emphasis on Chinese dialect coverage.

items.title: Any-Rate: half-bit multi-precision LLM quantization with coded bit-planes
items.summary: Introduces half-bit precisions in nested multi-precision quantization via coded bit-planes, letting a single checkpoint serve multiple bit-widths for on-device deployment under varying memory and energy budgets.

items.title: JetDiffusion pushes video generation speed with NVFP4 sparse attention
items.summary: Built on trainable Video Sparse Quantized Attention with custom NVFP4 low-bit kernels, combining sparsity and 4-bit quantization to attack the quadratic attention bottleneck in long-sequence generation.

items.title: Shifter Quantization keeps groupwise-quantized weights on native integer MMAs
items.summary: Reconstructs native-width integer dot products so groupwise-quantized LLM weights still span full dot products on standard GPU integer MMAs, improving low-bit accuracy while keeping efficient inference paths.

items.title: BReD: block replay dithering stabilizes low-bit EMA optimizer states
items.summary: Stabilizes the iterative dequantize-update-requantize loop of low-bit EMA optimizer states, substantially cutting training memory footprint without the instability seen in naive low-bit state storage.

items.title: Ollama v0.40.19-rc0 ships faster inkling2 paths and updated llama-server
items.summary: The release adds faster short-history handling, draft proposals and conversation snapshots for inkling2, compacted Engram history buffers in mlxrunner, and a llama-server version bump.

items.title: openset-llm v0.2.0: shared-prompt reuse makes --multi up to 2.8x faster
items.summary: Adds shared system-prompt reuse for multi-stream serving (1.8-2.8x faster agent steps on 8 vCPU/8 GB at 2-6 streams), a 3-minute bench/quick.sh speed check, a Docker Compose workflow and 22 fixes.

items.title: llama.cpp b12806 routes BMG D=256 single-query decode to the flash-attention kernel
items.summary: The SYCL decode routing fix follows the same-day b12804 CDNA bf16 MFMA operand fix, tightening AMD backend performance in the nightly builds.

items.title: Show HN: Faster Mac Use — background Chrome/macOS MCP with 5-lane routing skill
items.summary: A local-AI tooling project exposing Chrome and macOS control through a background MCP server with a 5-lane routing skill for agent clients.

items.title: inferzero pushes a 2022 Intel Arc A770 past 1,700 tokens/s prompt processing
items.summary: The open-source C++ engine reports an Arc A770 16GB processing a 4,096-token prompt with Qwen3.8-27B (IQ3_S) at over 1,700 tokens/s on Linux, roughly 38% faster than before, with two A770s reaching 3,345 t/s prefill on the MoE Qwen3.6-35B-A3B.

items.title: Qualcomm details multi-agent on-device setups on Snapdragon X Series CPUs
items.summary: A developer-blog walkthrough of building multi-agent systems on Snapdragon X Series CPUs with persistent on-device memory, combining the open-source Memanto store with Qualcomm GenieX — a current reference for NPU-equipped WoA laptops as local LLM hosts.

items.title: TSMC's A14 1.4nm-class node opens for chip design
items.summary: TSMC declared its A14 PDK v0.9 ready for design-in, with Boost Cells promising 14% higher performance or 23% lower power versus N2P; risk production is placed in late 2027.

items.title: Nvidia pauses AI GPU shipments to Southeast Asia under new export-license rules
items.summary: Server makers including Dell and Supermicro were told to suspend AI server shipments to Singapore, Thailand, Malaysia and Indonesia after the Commerce Department closed the China cloud-rental loophole, with a 90-day license window for cloud providers.

quick_hits.title: ModernELECTRA recipe debuts with EdgeCoder-31M and a 46-language 61M encoder
quick_hits.summary: Knowledgator's compact BERT-like encoders, trained on ~1T tokens with 8192-token context, fit classification and embedding duties in local RAG pipelines.

quick_hits.title: Hugging Face launches 'Swarms, Flocks, Gangs' multi-agent training series
quick_hits.summary: A hands-on series on building, training and evaluating multi-agent swarms with small open models, reproducible in about five hours on two H200s.

quick_hits.title: HiCal: offline calibration for hierarchical scale encoding in HiF4 quantization
quick_hits.summary: Improves block-scale selection for HiFloat4 block floating-point quantization in accurate low-bit LLM inference.

quick_hits.title: Stable Gated DeltaNet-2 tames recurrent state instability in linear attention
quick_hits.summary: Analyzes and mitigates recurrent state instability in Gated DeltaNet-2, improving in-context retrieval for long-sequence local inference.

quick_hits.title: Is 4 bits enough for EEG sleep staging? MXFP4, NVFP4 and FP8 benchmarked
quick_hits.summary: Thirteen post-training quantization configurations tested for small, energy-efficient on-device EEG sleep staging networks, with concrete wearable-scale PTQ guidance.

quick_hits.title: Karpathy: Claude Opus 5.5 builds a playable Civilization-style US map from 31 public data sources
quick_hits.summary: About 45K lines of code generated over 7 hours via Claude Code, with an interactive deployment parsing real Census, GDP and elevation data.

quick_hits.title: OpenAI posts GPT-6 family preprint on intrinsic protein design
quick_hits.summary: An internal model matched or beat specialized tools on shape design and molecular fitting, with lab validation by partner Onava across dozens of proteins and antibodies.

quick_hits.title: BharatGen releases Patram 1.5, a 7B open-weights VLM for Indian paperwork
quick_hits.summary: Reads bank statements, KYC forms, invoices and messy scans, flagging unreadable fields rather than hallucinating.

quick_hits.title: Nous Research ships Hermes Agent with an Obsidian connector
quick_hits.summary: The update treats Obsidian vaults as a shared local, private knowledge base under user control.

quick_hits.title: Altair Semiconductor raises $100M Series A for edge AI connectivity
quick_hits.summary: The Sony spin-off will fund mass production of its low-power ALT1550 cellular modem for AI glasses, wearables and industrial devices in 2027.

quick_hits.title: Onodrim Industries, ex-Palantir group behind a $300M Series A, lands in Turin
quick_hits.summary: The $1.3B-valuation group takes majority stakes in operating industrial and tech companies and is hiring managerial staff in Italy.

quick_hits.title: CGN invests in Ellycode to push Italian-made AI into 120,000+ SME users
quick_hits.summary: The Servicios group embeds the AI-native 'Elly' BI platform into its invoicing software, targeting Italy's SME AI adoption gap.
